messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up: I'm proposing we change the GPU lease controller from a cluster-scoped ClusterRole to a namespace-scoped Role + per-namespace RoleBinding. Ran into a deploy error tied to KMS-wrapped controller tokens during a recent rollout.
Samir Patel: Can you paste the deploy error/logs? was it 403 or a decrypt failure?
Maria Chen: 403 from the controller when trying to create ephemeral leases. Logs show KMS returns success but controller fails when exchanging token. snippet:```text
2026-02-12T14:22:03Z lease-controller error: failed to create Lease: leases.coordinator.io "gpu-pool-123" is forbidden: User "system:serviceaccount:infra:lease-controller" cannot create resource "leases" in API group "coordination.k8s.io" at the cluster scope
caused by: token exchange failed: KMSDecrypt: envelope not found
```
Devon Li: That looks like two issues tangled: RBAC scope + KMS envelope context missing from audit which makes postmortem hard.
Ana Gomez: Can we confirm whether the controller is using a short-lived KMS-wrapped bootstrap token or a long-lived SA token? If bootstrap, the envelope metadata must be logged.
Maria Chen: It's using bootstrap flow (we rotate envelopes every 6h). When we replaced ClusterRole with a narrow Role the controller lost access because some namespaces still had ClusterRoleBindings for older CA/sa combos.
SecBot: SECURITY ALERT: 1 failed deploy, 4 leases timed out, 0 escalations. Audit trace id: a1b2c3.
Samir Patel: Short-term mitigation: grant the lease-controller a temporary ClusterRoleBinding to get systems stable, then do a controlled refactor. We should not leave that live more than 24h.
Devon Li: Agreed. Long-term: namespace-scoped Role + per-namespace service-account mapping. Also add an admission/OPA gate to verify no controller tries to use cluster-scoped verbs for leases.
Maria Chen: Draft RBAC snippet I'm proposing (namespace-scoped Role):```yaml
kind: Role
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
metadata:
  name: gpu-lease-controller
  namespace: gpu-pool-{{NAMESPACE}}
rules:
- apiGroups: ["coordination.k8s.io"]
  resources: ["leases"]
  verbs: ["get","list","create","update","patch","delete"]
```
and a RoleBinding to bind the specific SA to that role.
Ana Gomez: For auditability: enable kube-apiserver audit policy to include requestBody for coordination.k8s.io/leases and log KMS envelope id as an annotation on Lease objects (lease.metadata.annotations.kms-envelope-id). That way KMS decrypts and the envelope id is traceable in a single place.
Samir Patel: We'll also need a short test to exercise token refresh paths. I can add a unit/integration test to the lease-controller repo to mock KMS returning envelope-not-found and verify controller retries gracefully and logs the envelope id.
Maria Chen: Plan I'm proposing: 1) Apply temporary ClusterRoleBinding (Samir) 2) Add audit policy change + annotation write (Ana) 3) Implement per-namespace Role + RoleBinding and migration script that updates namespaces (Maria) 4) Add OPA admission policy to block cluster-scoped lease verbs (Devon) 5) Canary rollout (1 namespace) and monitor (all) 6) Revoke temporary ClusterRoleBinding after canary passes.
Devon Li: Also add canary health checks: lease create latency, KMS decrypt errors count, and RBAC denied count. Wire to console dashboards and alert if degrade > 5% for 15m.
Ana Gomez: One more: coordinate with infra to ensure KMS key policy allows the controller's KMS principal to describe/decrypt envelopes during migration window. I'll open a support ticket with KMS team.
Maria Chen: I'll create the migration PR and the kube audit policy change. Creating SEC ticket now: SEC-4382 and linking repo PRs.
Samir Patel: Ack. I'll handle the emergency ClusterRoleBinding and the extra test.
SecBot: NOTE: Temporary ClusterRoleBinding created by @Samir for 24h window. Watch SEC-4382 for follow-ups.
Maria Chen: Thanks all — please react with :thumbsup: when you ack the plan. I'll post the PR link once ready.
